description: [PAID $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] LaunchCheck full report for one public URL (GET /launchcheck/full?url=&format=json|html; alias /launchcheck?url=&tier=full). Includes the free-tier checks (status, HTTPS/redirects, title/description, Open Graph/Twitter card, robots.txt/sitemap/noindex) plus up to 50 links found on that page checked for breakage, og:image load check, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 390x844 JPEG screenshots, edge TTFB and real-browser load time, image alt text, heading outline, mobile overflow, and a P1-P3 prioritized fix list with copy-paste fixes. One URL only — not a multi-page crawl, not a penetration test, and it does not scan client JS for leaked keys (see /api/audit). HTML capped at 1.5 MB; page fetch 10 s, each link 8 s, max 5 redirects. Screenshots use Cloudflare Browser Rendering (40/day quota); if the quota is hit the report still returns with screenshots.status "unavailable". Public http(s) hostnames on ports 80/443 only (SSRF-guarded). Errors (invalid URL 400, unreachable 502) and non-2xx responses are never charged. MCP tool: launchcheck_full. Docs: /launch-check/.

url.description: Public http(s) URL (hostname, not IP). Private/reserved addresses are refused. Optional: defaults to https://example.com.
